title: service status says no service is installed while the app's host service runs; descriptor says stopped while connect status says Online
body:
Found in shakeout round 2 (38fbc3d0d9), macOS with the OpenAgents desktop app's host running:

```
$ openagents service status
openagents service: no host service is configured under ~/.openagents/host; run `openagents service install` first
$ openagents service descriptor
9c9122…f316 stopped generation 1790644485 version 285a86…c1a4 on 127.0.0.1:47100
update committed to 285a86… from f6413f…
$ openagents connect status
Online. Your phone can reach this computer.  host 9c9122…f316 …
```
A newcomer is told to install a service that already runs (via the app), and the descriptor contradicts the live state. Expected: `service status` recognises the app's host service (launchd/systemd unit), shows running/stopped from the live host, and only suggests install when nothing runs; descriptor output in plain words (state, version short hash, address).
